text.title: 篱笆后的建筑
text.situation:
看过田地后，小路经过一座储存谷物的谷仓。马站在隔壁的马厩里。更远处，牛在乳品场旁休息。一位工人提着桶走进侧门。农夫把这些动物称为家畜：它们既是农场工作与资产的一部分，也是每天需要照料的生命。

林：盒子里的两个样品是什么？
农夫：绵羊的羊毛，以及植物的棉纤维。手干净的话，可以摸摸。棉花不是这里种的，来自另一座农场。
玛雅：盒子上面的照片呢？
农夫：是国外的一座咖啡种植园。那些树主要为一种作物种植，看起来与我们的小田很不同。

访客室内
纤维样品上方挂着咖啡种植园照片。旁边是一份饥荒记述：当时一个社区面临极严重的食物短缺。下一次参访将讨论食物如何到达城镇。

paragraphs.en: After the fields, the path passed a barn where grain was stored. Horses stood in the stable next door. Farther away, cattle were resting beside the dairy. A worker carried a bucket through a side door. The farmer called these animals livestock: they were part of the work and value of the farm, as well as living things that needed daily care.

paragraphs.en:
Lin: What are the two samples in that box?
Farmer: Wool from a sheep, and cotton fibre from a plant. Feel them with clean hands. The cotton wasn’t grown here; it came from another farm.
Maya: And the photograph above the box?
Farmer: A coffee plantation abroad. The trees are grown for one main crop. It looks very different from our small fields.

paragraphs.en:
In the visitor room
A photograph of a coffee plantation hangs above the fibre samples. Beside it is an account of a famine, when a community faced an extreme shortage of food. The next visit will include a discussion of how food reaches the town.
